description: Explicit pinned SHAs for the cross-repository integrity workflow (.github/workflows/cross-repo-integrity.yml). Update deliberately, in the same PR as the change that requires a new pin, never silently.

data-connect.note: Squash commit of data-connect#120 into PDP-Connect/data-connect main (merged 2026-09-14T19:19:55Z), captured from main's head and confirmed to BE that head via `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main` — never a PR head. Supersedes ed0dbaca5 (data-connect#116). #120 re-vendors data-connect's copies of this repo's claude_code connector sources, index.ts and artifact-capture.ts, from data-connectors 63db357da, so both sides now carry the complete-tool-result-body bytes data-connectors#100 introduced. Under the previous pin those two files were the only mismatch drift job (b) connector-sources reported; at this SHA that job passes with all 31 vendored files across all six connectors byte-identical to canonical. This is a pin-only change: this repo's #105 deleted drift job (c) tarball-digests and the hand-vendored runtime tarballs it compared, so no repack accompanies the bump. This pin backs THREE drift jobs, none of which involve a packed tarball: (a) collector-definitions, which compares this repo's connector registry against data-connect's committed collector-definitions.generated.ts using packages/local-collector/scripts/generate-collector-definitions-snapshot.ts; (b) connector-sources, which byte-compares the six connector directories data-connect vendors from this repo (claude_code, codex, google_takeout, imessage, apple_photos, google_messages); and (e) collector-packaging-manifest, which compares the registry against packages/local-collector/tsconfig.build.json, the compile list. Those three are source-level comparisons against files committed in data-connect, so they still need an explicit, deliberately-moved SHA — a mutable branch ref would let an upstream change flip them without review. What this pin NO LONGER backs: drift job (c) tarball-digests, retired along with the hand-vendored pdpp-collector-runtime-0.0.1.tgz / pdpp-connector-protocol-0.0.1.tgz. Both packages now install from the npm registry at an exact pinned version, so their provenance is the registry's immutable published artifact plus the lockfile's integrity hash — not a digest list maintained by hand in this repo. The companion `data-connect-1-0-0` pin was deleted in the same change: it existed ONLY to give job (c)'s 1.0.0 leg a second, later data-connect checkout to repack pdpp's 1.0.0 tarballs from, and with job (c) gone it had no remaining reader. packages/collector-runtime and packages/connector-protocol are likewise dropped from the pin-freshness path list for this repo, because npm version resolution — not a path diff against this SHA — is now what governs those two packages.

pdpp.note: Head of PDP-Connect/pdpp main on 2026-09-14, the merge of pdpp#362 'chore(connectors): remove the frozen duplicate connector tree', captured from main's head via `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main` and confirmed an ancestor of main via `git merge-base --is-ancestor` — never a PR head, for the reason the data-connect entry's superseded-pin history above records. Moved from 7fc529a64 to clear the pin-freshness pdpp leg, which has failed on every pull request in this repo since pdpp#362 landed: that leg diffs the pinned commit against pdpp's tracked ref restricted to packages/reference-contract, and #362 edited packages/reference-contract/tsconfig.json — the sole tracked-path change in the range, per `git diff --name-only 7fc529a64 6f4bf5049 -- packages/reference-contract`. The edit is comment-only. #362 deleted pdpp's packages/polyfill-connectors tree, and the tsconfig's prose had cited that tree three times as the exemplar its Node-ESM and strict-plus settings matched; #362 rewrote those sentences to stand on their own. No compilerOptions key or value changed, so nothing this repo type-checks against moved. Drift job (d) reference-contract therefore compares identical bytes before and after: `git log 7fc529a64..6f4bf5049 -- packages/reference-contract/src` is empty, and the only other commit in the range, pdpp#363, touches site content alone. Verified by running the job's own check-reference-contract-drift.mjs against a clean clone at this SHA — every documented stand-in module matches its canonical pdpp source. pdpp#361 (the prior pin) and #362 between them also deleted pdpp's vendor/ and packages/polyfill-connectors/, but no job in this workflow reads either tree any more: the tarball-digests job that consumed pdpp's vendor/SHA256SUMS is retired, and this repo installs the runtime/protocol packages from the registry. Those deletions need no further change here, and since pdpp will not resurrect either tree, they never will. This is a pin-reference update only: no file in this repository changes besides this entry.
